data.name: Data mining
data.detailed_description:
Data mining is a colorful 2D minimalist puzzle game that combines data collection, obstacle avoidance, challenging traps, and abstract visual design. Explore vibrant puzzle environments, collect uncorrupted data files, and unlock the exit in this engaging collection of logic puzzles and precision-based challenges.

Enter a world where every data file matters. Your objective is to collect all the files scattered throughout each level while avoiding dangerous obstacles and traps. Only after gathering the required data will the previously locked passage open, allowing you to reach the exit and complete the challenge.

Enjoy intuitive collect-and-escape puzzle gameplay that rewards careful observation, logical thinking, and precise movement. Study the level layout, identify dangerous areas, and determine how to reach every file safely. Each puzzle encourages you to plan your route, react to hazards, and discover an effective way to complete the objective.

With 50 levels of colorful puzzle challenges, Data mining offers an enjoyable combination of classic 2D puzzles, obstacle avoidance, and skill-based gameplay. Explosions, dangerous traps, and varied level layouts add excitement to your journey, making careful decisions and precise timing essential for success.

Immerse yourself in the distinctive atmosphere of minimalist abstract art, where bright colors, geometric visuals, and clean environments create a recognizable visual identity. The simple presentation keeps the focus on collecting files, overcoming obstacles, and reaching the exit without unnecessary distractions.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, challenging logic puzzles, retro-inspired 2D games, or minimalist brain teasers, Data mining offers an accessible yet rewarding single-player experience. Explore each level, collect every required file, avoid dangerous traps, and enjoy the satisfaction of unlocking the path to victory.

With its colorful 2D abstract graphics, engaging background music, and straightforward gameplay concept, Data mining delivers a focused puzzle experience that combines simplicity with challenge. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, casual players, and anyone who enjoys collectible-based puzzles, obstacle avoidance, and compact brain-teasing adventures.

Key Features

  • 50 challenging puzzle levels – Explore a collection of colorful 2D puzzles that test your logic, concentration, and precision.

  • Data collection gameplay – Collect all uncorrupted data files to unlock the exit and complete each level.

  • Collect-and-escape challenges – Find the safest route through each puzzle environment while gathering the required files.

  • Dangerous traps and obstacles – Avoid hazards and carefully plan your movements to complete challenging levels.

  • Explosions and environmental hazards – Encounter explosive challenges that add excitement and danger to the gameplay.

  • Logic puzzles and brain teasers – Exercise your problem-solving skills, spatial awareness, and attention to detail.

  • Precision and timing challenges – Navigate obstacles carefully and react to dangerous situations.

  • Colorful minimalist art – Enjoy vibrant 2D graphics with a clean, abstract visual style.

  • Retro-inspired puzzle aesthetics – Discover a straightforward puzzle experience with a charming old-school atmosphere.

  • Engaging background music – Enjoy an energetic soundtrack that accompanies your puzzle-solving journey.

  • Simple but challenging objectives – Easy-to-understand goals combined with puzzles that reward patience and careful planning.

  • Unlockable exits – Collect every required data file to open the previously closed passage and finish the level.

  • 100 Steam Achievements – Complete challenges and unlock achievements as you progress.

  • Steam Cloud support – Keep your game progress synchronized across supported devices.

  • Single-player puzzle experience – Explore levels, overcome obstacles, and solve puzzles at your own pace.

Collect the data. Avoid the traps. Unlock the exit. Complete every challenge in Data mining!
